LESSON: MANAGEMENT OF SOLID WASTE

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Matter 2.1 Properties of Matter (14 lessons) ● Meaning of matter ● States of mat
Topic 2.2: Management of Solid Waste

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Management of Solid Waste. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Management of Solid Waste
2. Practise Management of Solid Waste at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Management of Solid Waste

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Management of Solid Waste
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Management of Solid Waste. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Management of Solid Waste at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Management of Solid Waste at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Management of Solid Waste
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Management of Solid Waste. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Management of Solid Waste using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Management of Solid Waste in the examples.
2. Explain Management of Solid Waste to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Management of Solid Waste.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Management of Solid Waste using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Management of Solid Waste important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Management of Solid Waste
2. Practise Management of Solid Waste at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Management of Solid Waste

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
